builder.adolescence.lede: Three things happened to you before turning 15. Roll and see — results change your attributes, record and opportunities.
builder.adolescence.title: Youth
builder.attrHint: Tap ⓘ (or hover) to see what each number does and how it is made. Skills are a roll-under target: d20 ≤ value succeeds. Balanced builds survive longer.
builder.attributes.lede: Spend 20 points (each attribute 6–14). Lowering Credit Score gives you points but makes life harder. Not sure? Use a suggested spread.
builder.attributes.title: Attributes
builder.career.lede: Optional. Each term = +2 years, attribute changes and two random events. More terms = more experience, but age catches up. Stop whenever you like.
builder.career.title: Career
builder.careerEnded: An event ended your career phase. Continue to the next step.
builder.class.lede: How you operate in a fight. Pick freely — your past does not restrict it. Your two main stats set your Class TN.
builder.class.title: Class
builder.confirmReroll: Re-rolling youth should be agreed with the GM. Undo all three events (and any career terms)?
builder.confirmRestart: Discard this draft and start over?
builder.debt.lede: Nobody goes underground for fun. Your special debt is why you take dangerous jobs. Roll it, or pick one with your GM.
builder.debt.title: Debt
builder.gmOffer: At the table: the GM can have your backstory written for you, or use the prompt below with your own AI.
builder.identity.lede: Who is playing, and who are they playing?
builder.identity.title: Identity
builder.ifNotPaid: What happens if you don't pay
builder.pastePlaceholder: Paste the generated story here (or write your own)
builder.quiz.lede: Six quick “what would you do?” questions suggest a class. Optional — skip it if you already know what you want.
builder.quiz.title: Playstyle
builder.review.lede: Last look. Everything here can still be adjusted on the sheet later.
builder.review.title: Review
builder.sentToGm: Sent to the GM: it appears on your Dossier once they send it. You can finish the character meanwhile.
builder.story.lede: Optional. Copy the prompts into your favourite AI (or write it yourself), paste the backstory back, add a portrait.
builder.story.title: Story

engine.addMark: Name an enemy (e.g. Heavy), then Enter
engine.bluescreen: deck locked this round and every sustained hack crashed. Reboots at {heat} heat at round end.
engine.bluescreenGhost: deck locked this round; Ghost kept your sustained hacks alive. Reboots at {heat} heat at round end.
engine.brownoutNext: rig offline until the end of next round.
engine.brownoutNow: rig offline until the end of this round.
engine.buyDeck: No deck owned. Buy one in Gear → Decks.
engine.buyOptic: No optic: bare AR lenses. Buy one in Gear → Market → Optics.
engine.hackerHint: Instant hacks only add heat; sustained ones also lock RAM until released. Range: a device in sight, or within 10 squares on a network you have pinged. Most hacks only touch cybernetic or synthetic targets. Deck vents 1 heat per round.
engine.inDarkHint: Unlit, and the GM agrees they can't see you: counts as Unseen (2 Tells).
engine.noClass: No class selected. Choose a subclass in the Dossier tab.
engine.noMarks: No enemies yet: name them below as they show up.
engine.noMods: No mods owned. RAM expansions and cooling upgrades are in Gear → Deck mods.
engine.nothingEquipped: Nothing equipped. Equip up to {n} abilities below — swap freely between combats. They light up as ready when your {resource} allows.
engine.overheat: Heat at the cap: at the end of the round the deck Blue Screens and every sustained hack crashes. Vent heat now (Thermal Dump) or release what you can spare.
engine.overheatGhost: Heat at the cap: at the end of the round the deck Blue Screens (Ghost keeps your sustained hacks running).
engine.reboot: Hard reboot in progress — deck offline for the rest of this round and the next.
engine.resonantHint: Both faces fire, then Sync drops to 0
engine.resonantReady: your next ability can be a Resonant cast: both faces, then Sync 0.
engine.scavengerHint: Each turn: 1 Tell (2 when Unseen: full cover and no attack last round). Max 3 per enemy. Tap an enemy to make it your target for abilities. When you hit, the attack window asks whether to spend Tells for Exploit (+1d4 each).
engine.smugglerHint: Wounded smugglers drift +1 toward Adrenaline at round end.
engine.soldierHint: Damage dealt ×{dealt} · damage taken ×{taken}. TP reset to 0 at the start of each combat.
engine.techHint: +1 Sync per ability used and per round you hold your mode. Switching mode is free but resets Sync. Losing HP costs 1 Sync.
engine.title: engine
engine.toPlace.one: This turn: place 1 Tell on an enemy you can see.
engine.toPlace.other: This turn: place {n} Tells on enemies you can see.
engine.zoneCold: Cold: +2 TN on gun attacks (already in the Attack TN).
engine.zoneHot: Hot: +1 damage on every damage roll and +1 square per move (already applied).
